title: Kacie Kintz:
headline: Adopt-A-Block served around 500 people last year. In September it served over 2,500. The director explains how the line grew, and why the Dream Center meets every family with love and no strings attached.
story: Kacie Kintz is the director of the Dream Center Dallas. On the 10 Oct Adopt-A-Block she walked the lot with Kalindi and gave the numbers in her own words: around 500 people last year, over 2,500 last month, 1,400 people in two hours on a Thursday, a whole street closed for the line, families who camp out the night before. This cut is the client's style test for the day. Series: Outrageous Generosity.

Loops: L1 “How did it grow so fast?” opens at 0:00 and closes at 0:10 with the 1,400 line. L2 “Why do they keep going?” opens at 0:00 and closes in the button, “break the cycle”. Stakes: the line is five times longer than a year ago, and families sleep on the street to be in it.
do: Open on Kacie's face, already talking, with the hook text on frame 1.
Number pops when she says the numbers: 500, 2,500, 1,400. Both lines of each pop come on together.
Let every last word finish: keep about 0.4 s of air after “way”, “massive”, “meet it” and “live that way”.
Cut to the car line and the trunk loading under the numbers.
Let “break the cycle” land last. Hold one second on her.
dont: No logo, name or fade at 0:00.
No trash, empty boxes or clutter in any shot. The client said so on the 1 Oct call.
No full names for neighbors. First names only, and only if they say it on camera.
No money amounts anywhere. Do not use the renovation and its cost (Interview 4, 00:56 to 01:00).
No caption that flashes for one or two words. Each caption stays up long enough to read.

1080×1920 at 30 fps. Conform all clips to it.

Each number pop shows both lines at once: 500, 2,500, 1,400, in her words.
No last word is clipped: “way”, “massive”, “meet it”, “live that way”.
Captions read “We love you.”, “If someone…”, “the need is massive.”, “And we'll be here to meet it.”, “Just come to the Dream Center”, “The Dream Center really is…”.
No trash, empty boxes or clutter in any B-roll shot.
The renovation cost is not in the video. No money amounts.
The end card lines come on early; “Adopt-A-Block. Every month.” stays to the end.
